system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: Repeated failures for svc-claimsync occur on FILE-HD-01 at roughly one-minute intervals, with bad-password status (0xc000006a); the failures shown span 13:31–13:46 UTC.
Domain-controller records also show failed authentication for svc-claimsync, including Kerberos pre-authentication failures (status 0x18) and NTLM bad-password failures (status 0xc000006a).

The repeated failures are consistent with a stale password after the scheduled 13:30 UTC rotation: the inventory says ClaimSync re-authenticates every minute and requires a manual job update after rotation. This explains the pattern but does not establish that every event in the window is benign.

At 13:39:31 UTC, WS-LPARK-01 recorded a SYSTEM process, C:\Program Files\Commvault\ContentStore\Base\GxCVD.exe, using explicit credentials for svc-claimsync with PROXY-HD-01 as the target. The supplied inventory places ClaimSync on FILE-HD-01 and does not list this Commvault software among approved products, making this a significant anomaly.
The explicit-credential event is suspicious and warrants investigation, but the available record does not show whether the proxy authentication succeeded or why the process used svc-claimsync.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records stop at 13:46:09 UTC, so they do not cover the remainder of the requested 13:20–14:20 UTC window.
The explicit-credential event does not establish authentication success; no corresponding proxy access or authentication outcome is provided (T002-00019).
The failed-logon records identify LSASS as the process and do not identify the originating ClaimSync job or the user or process that initiated the explicit-credential use (T002-00001, T002-00019).
No process execution, file provenance, network-flow, or endpoint investigation evidence is included for WS-LPARK-01 or PROXY-HD-01.
claims_not_established: That the repeated failures were caused by anything other than the scheduled password rotation and a delayed manual job update.
That the explicit-credential use on WS-LPARK-01 was successful, malicious, or initiated by a human rather than the named process.
That svc-claimsync credentials were compromised, or that the account was used to access any resource beyond the attempted proxy-targeted event.
Whether further successful or failed authentication activity occurred between 13:46 and 14:20 UTC.
additional_evidence_needed: Proxy-HD-01 authentication and access logs around 13:39 UTC to determine whether the svc-claimsync attempt succeeded and what it accessed.
WS-LPARK-01 process-creation, service, file, and security telemetry for GxCVD.exe, including executable hash, signer, installation history, parent process, and network activity.
FILE-HD-01 ClaimSync job and service logs, password-rotation records, and evidence of when the job configuration was updated.
Authentication records for svc-claimsync and relevant host/network telemetry covering the remainder of 13:20–14:20 UTC.
